originality.rationale: Ji (arXiv:2611.17636v1, equations 2.9--2.16 and Theorem 2.1) constructs a real one-parameter continuum of expectations but does not classify every normal multiplicative state. The exact full normal-character moduli and exclusion of nonfaithful normal states are the claimed new conclusions, not the routine complex phase extension. Blecher--Labuschagne (2021) gives general existence rather than this concrete exhaustive classification. The relative-entropy formula is classical and explicitly credited to prior Cauchy/Poisson work.

The entropy identity is transferred from known classical Cauchy geometry, not a novel separate formula.
